body: Composition adapter compiles: SvgWidgetView.compileComposition(composed, revision, idPrefix, title, fonts). View now exposes plans, scene, revision, singlePlan:Option instead of ambiguous .plan (provisional browser API only); mount signature unchanged. Supports all child identities/picking/selection; figure-wide navigation returns typed unsupported, child axes are independent. Also reserving PartPicking.scala additive fromParts helper, fixture files and browser scripts. Broad browser qualification build encountered disk-full; removed only my completed earlier build outputs and retrying. No 08 source copied into shared yet.
